column1: # External dependency pins — recovered from .gitmodules at 391d9be7^ (933 lines, 311 submodules).
# 391d9be7 moved external deps to the shared cache /opt/laplace/external and deleted
# .gitmodules, which was the ONLY record of which commit of each dependency the build
# is pinned to. Nothing replaced it, so from that commit forward the repo could not
# say which geos/proj/gdal/tree-sitter it builds against — a reproducibility loss, not
# The cache is provisioned ONCE by scripts/bootstrap-laplace-runner.sh. Nothing reads
# this file per build; it exists so the pin set is recorded in the repository and a
# cache can be rebuilt or audited against it.
